name: Abyssal Signal Feedback
description: One-hour retrofuturistic undersea glitch console instrument with caustics, sonar rings, chromatic tearing, CRT pressure, spiral feedback, and decompression fade.

inputs.name: u_image
inputs.description: Current input image or video frame.

inputs.name: u_bubble_depth
inputs.description: Bubble generator depth, age, and radius texture.

inputs.name: u_bubble_highlight
inputs.description: Bubble generator highlight and sparkle texture.

parameters.name: Phase Override
parameters.purpose: Set to -1 for automatic one-hour timeline, or 0-6 to force a phase.

parameters.name: Bubble Mix
parameters.purpose: Blend amount for bubble generator source textures.

parameters.name: Bubble Refraction
parameters.purpose: How strongly bubble refraction offsets the source image.

parameters.name: Bubble Highlight
parameters.purpose: Brightness multiplier for bubble rim and sparkle highlights.

timeline.name: Abyss Boot
timeline.notes: Soft caustics, low feedback, minimal chroma, slow underwater drift.

timeline.name: Sonar Sweep
timeline.notes: Sonar rings and subtle chromatic shimmer become more visible.

timeline.name: Datamosh Tide
timeline.notes: Block tearing and horizontal displacement increase.

timeline.name: Feedback Tunnel
timeline.notes: Feedback mix rises and spiral pull begins.

timeline.name: Brainwipe CRT
timeline.notes: Scanlines, vignette, chroma, and feedback pressure intensify.

timeline.name: Max Chaos
timeline.notes: Full glitch bloom with sonar, tearing, spiral feedback, and beat pulses.

timeline.name: Decompression
timeline.notes: Gradual reduction of chaos, feedback, chroma, and distortion.

performance_notes: Single GLSL 330 fragment shader for the full one-hour slot.
All modes are selected and blended through uniforms from the Lua controller.
Uses only u_image and u_feedback as external texture inputs.
Noise and fbm are kept to short fixed loops for live performance.
